_note: Inputs to scripts/31_record_stein.py. Every number here is printed by scripts/30_stein_cv.py (verify, span) or scripts/28_learned_corrector.py --mode fit / --mode ship (lean); this file exists so the ledger row and docs/stein_cv.md quote the same bytes.

verify.notes: scripts/30 --mode verify, 4 local MLPs (seeds 900000..900003) x 200,000 samples x 3 random unit directions x 256 neurons = 3,072 independent tests per psi family, four families. h = c.grad psi - (c.x) psi with c.grad psi from a forward-mode tangent pass v <- (v W) * 1{z>0}. rms mean(h) over the four families and four MLPs is 0.65-1.30x the Monte-Carlo standard error; rms z-score 0.785-1.278; largest single |z| 3.825 over 12,288 tests. The identity holds EXACTLY: Stein's identity IS the statement that a_c^+ = (c.x) - c.grad is the adjoint of c.grad in L2(gamma), and a_c annihilates constants. The ReLU kink set has measure zero and the network is Lipschitz, so rectification costs the identity nothing. Quoted rms_mean_h/rms_se/ratio are for psi = relu(z^32_j) on MLP 900000.

span.notes: scripts/30 --mode span, 4 local MLPs x 240,000 samples, two directions (top left singular vector of the mean Jacobian E[x^T y], and one random unit vector), coefficients fitted on one half and explained variance read on the other, both ways, best over a ridge grid, so no p/N inflation at p = 2048. Total-variance weighted as in docs/floor_theorem.md. FAILS the 0.75 bar by 6.5x. H1 = 25.2% reproduces f_1 = 0.276 and H1+H2 = 39.0% reproduces the 38-48% of the barrier's k=2 amendment from a sixth independent estimator, so the measurement validates itself. The only block above 3% is psi = z^32_i (11.0%), which is uncentred and therefore carries the k=1 Hermite CV as a summand -- which is why the whole dictionary adds only +0.44 points on top of H1+H2. exact_ceiling_all_256_directions is |k_j|^2/Var(y_j)^2 with k_j = (1/2) E[x ybar_j^2], a bound that holds for EVERY direction c at once (random, mean-Jacobian, W^32[:,j], per-neuron) because Var(-a_c^+ psi) >= |c|^2 Var(psi); estimated as the cross-half product k^A . k^B so it is unbiased. Mechanism: a_c^+ raises the Hermite degree, so the covariance with the target is an adjacent-degree pairing while the variance cost is the full diagonal. The psi that would maximise the alignment is c.grad y_j itself, which for a ReLU net is discontinuous across the kinks, hence not weakly differentiable, hence exactly what Stein's identity forbids.

lean.estimator: corrected_sparse_kernel(tau=2.5, n=8500, P=150, kmax=2) with a 15-feature ridge head, lambda=1e-8, fitted on 384 generated MLPs
lean.notes: scripts/28 --mode fit --val-frac 0.2 --install, then --mode score / --mode ship on the official 100-MLP suite (N=1e9 reference, so raw_mse is leaderboard-comparable). Thirteen of the 28 head columns dropped -- the Rao-Blackwell gap and the two sample-Edgeworth terms, the multiplicative shrink (mu, mu*Phi), the weight/suite scalars (wn, w4, vbar, arms), cv3 (zero at CV_KMAX=2) and sd_mc -- every one of which measures at exactly 1.000x in the leave-one-group-out table of docs/learned_corrector.md sec 5. Between them they cost EIGHT passes over the (8500, 256) sample array: d^3 and d^4 for the Edgeworth terms and mean(x*x) for Var(relu z). A ninth goes because v is now mean(z^2) - m^2 rather than a centred copy of the array (1e-6 relative on v at rms|alpha| = 3.44; the pilot already used this form). The head is RE-FITTED on the 15 remaining columns, not masked. Untouched test split: 1.353x against the full design's 1.354x, so the accuracy cost is nil and the whole gain is in C/B. adj1/adj2/adj3, prev_*, gain* and the ablation come from ONE interleaved run in which the previous 28-feature kernel (taken from git show HEAD:whestfloor/kernels.py) and the lean one were scored per MLP in the same process, so the residual wall time -- the only machine-dependent term -- was measured under identical load. The shipped file itself (--mode ship, run alone) reads raw 3.7157e-6, F/B 0.0919, adjusted 3.9998e-7 / 4.5851e-7 / 5.1705e-7, 0 raises, max C 0.1313 of B, fallback probe finite at raw 1.0873e-5 and C/B 0.0948. damp=0 still reads 5.8050e-6, the number published for the pre-corrector ship, to five significant figures. N was re-swept against the freed budget and does NOT buy samples: N=9000 and N=9500 lower raw MSE to 3.5842e-6 and 3.5337e-6 and RAISE adjusted to 0.996x and 0.964x of this configuration. submission/corrector.npz is 322 bytes and regenerates byte-identically (sha256 eff7515db0c1b0a2...).
